claims: TSA employees worked without pay for 44 days during a partial government shutdown.
Many TSA employees received retroactive paychecks on March 30, 2026.
Most TSA employees received retroactive paychecks covering their missed, unpaid work hours since the funding lapse began on Feb. 14, 2026.
President Trump issued an executive order requiring the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) to pay TSA officers directly.
President Trump's executive order aims to alleviate staffing shortages caused by workers taking sick leave due to financial strain.
Thousands of other DHS employees continue to work without pay.
Some TSA employees reported the initial paychecks did not cover the entire period missed.
Al Jazeera reported long security lines caused by high call-out rates during the shutdown
